name: 1N5817
description: Lowest-voltage 1N5817/18/19 Schottky rectifier, 20V / 1A in DO-41. Very low forward drop (~0.45V) and fast switching for low-voltage DC/DC, freewheeling, polarity protection and OR-ing where conduction loss matters.
typical_application: Output/catch and freewheel rectifier in low-voltage switchers, and series polarity protection where minimum drop matters.
gotchas: Schottky leakage is milliamp-scale (up to 1mA at 25C, 10mA at 100C), far worse than a silicon PN diode; bad for low-standby-current designs
only 20V reverse, easy to exceed with ringing; size for peak/transient reverse voltage or step up to 1N5818 (30V) / 1N5819 (40V)
low Vf is the whole point vs 1N400x, but it climbs above ~1A; watch thermal runaway from leakage at high temperature
